paragraphs: Hyman mentions him in Midrash Tehillim 22:3 and records the conjecture of הרש״ב that the reading should be ר״ח bar Ada.[^1][^2]

notes.text: הרש״ב is read as Rabbi Shlomo Buber, editor of Midrash Tehillim.

The selected OYW digital paragraph of Midrash Tehillim 22 has Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba without the Jaffa qualifier. It does not freshly establish Hyman’s exact qualified heading, the proposed ר״ח bar Ada form, or an expanded title for that proposal. The heading therefore retains R', and הרש״ב and ר״ח are left as supplied in the body. The existing note’s Shlomo Buber expansion is retained historically and here, without treating it as a fresh collation of Buber’s edition or admitting Hyman’s conjecture as a correction.
